title: Aromatic Saffron Kenyan Rice Hash
description: A mustardy, chewy take on the classic Kenyan dish, featuring crispy rice paper sheets and a protein-boosting twist.
instructions: Soak 4-6 rice paper sheets in warm water for at least 15 minutes before use.
Chop the onion and saut6 the garlic in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of cast-iron skillet oil to the skillet and stir to coat.
Add the soaked rice paper sheets to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the rice paper sheets from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the rice vinegar, mustard oil, and protein powder of choice. Stir to combine.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, stirring to coat in the flavorful liquid.
Stir in the soaked and drained saffron threads, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the cooked rice to a serving dish and top with chopped cilantro and scallions (if using).
